capabilities: Capture tasks and ideas into daily note sections
Manage lightweight projects with memo files and multi-project task links
View tasks, ideas and repeating tasks on lists, boards and 3-day/week/month calendars
Pull read-only events from CalDAV or Feishu calendars and write task reminders to them
Export event reminders as .ics files or phone calendar entries
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README states the Feishu API provider, Android notification delivery and two-device Nutstore sync are unverified on real devices. It is free with no paid tiers; the data folder is a legacy 'TaskCalendar' directory hidden from the file explorer.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in dashboard for capturing quick ideas, tracking lightweight projects and repeating tasks, and viewing them on calendars or boards.

relations.evidence: If Periodic Notes manages daily notes, that interface uses its daily configuration.
Sync it together with diary, Projects and TaskCalendar using Nutstore Sync.
The Feishu API provider needs an authorized user token and calendar permissions.
a Tasker task with Browse URL can open the copied URI

requires.name: Feishu account with calendar permissions or CalDAV credentials

summary: Personal task, idea and project manager with list, board and calendar views that stores records as Markdown sections in daily notes.
